name: self_fracture_scape
label: The Breaking Earth of Memory
poeticVision: Feel the very ground beneath you betray your steps as your memories falter. The world is not a backdrop; it is a direct, agonizing reflection of your dissolving self. Every forgotten name, every lost moment, tears another chasm into the reality you navigate, forcing you to literally outrun the crumbling wreckage of who you once were.

parameters.name: lyra_identity_cohesion
parameters.description: A normalized value (0.0 to 1.0) representing Lyra's current identity cohesion. 1.0 is full identity, 0.0 is complete loss. This drives both visual and physical effects.

parameters.name: crumble_thresholds
parameters.description: An array of float values (0.0 to 1.0) that define the identity cohesion levels at which a new physical crumbling event is triggered. Values should be sorted descending.

parameters.name: affected_materials
parameters.description: A list of ShaderMaterial resources that will have their 'identity_cohesion' uniform updated by this manager, applying visual distortion.

parameters.name: crumble_zones_root
parameters.description: The NodePath to a parent Node3D that contains all individual 'crumble zone' Node3D children. Each child Node3D should contain RigidBody3D parts and optional GPUParticles3D.

verdict: The world itself weeps with Lyra's fading self, turning every step into a desperate dance on the precipice of oblivion.
impact: This invention transforms the game environment from a static backdrop into a dynamic, hostile entity that directly mirrors the protagonist's internal struggle. Players will experience constant, visceral tension as the very ground beneath them betrays their steps, forcing urgent navigation and amplifying the emotional weight of Lyra's fading identity. It creates a profound, unforgettable connection between Lyra's internal state and the external world's physical reality.
